name: SDN Standards Discovery Flow
description: HTTP standards-discovery flow (gateway loop G.2): a $HTQ HttpRequest enters on the http-request trigger, foundation/http-route discover emits the routing decision (standards | not_found), hostcap/p2p-discovery standards issues the policy-mediated p2p.standards_snapshot hostcall (newest stored signed $PNM per (peer, standard), attribution from the record store's provenance) and re-emits the decision, foundation/discovery-shape standards splices the $PNM frames verbatim / encodes the bare-array json presentation and the shared FNV-1a etag, and foundation/http-respond assembles the final $HTR envelope (200/304/404) delivered to the host-model egress sink. Bridge linkage: the only host crossing is the declared p2p_read hostcall.

triggers.description: One $HTQ HttpRequest envelope per invocation, pumped by the host at the flow ingress.

api.tagDescription: Peer and standards discovery served by the G.2 gateway flows (wasm; routing, format selection and ETag logic run inside the module; snapshots come from the policy-mediated p2p_read capability).

routes.summary: Standards published across known peers, with publishers
routes.description: One record per (publishing peer, standard) pair — the newest stored signed PNM for that pair, derived from the record store's PNM provenance (FILE_ID names the standard, e.g. celestrak:gp:OMM.fbs:…). Default encoding: aligned size-prefixed $PNM frames (signed, verifiable). format=json: bare array of {peer_id, standard, schema, file_id, file_name, cid, publish_timestamp}.

params.name: format
params.description: Response encoding: flatbuffer = aligned size-prefixed $PNM FlatBuffer stream (default), json = bare JSON array of publication records.

200.description: Publication record stream. Metadata rides in headers on BOTH encodings: X-SDN-Record-Count and a content-derived ETag.

application/vnd.sdn.flatbuffers.stream.description: Aligned size-prefixed $PNM FlatBuffer frames — the newest publish notification per (peer, standard).

application/json.description: Bare top-level JSON array of publication records (format=json).

304.description: Not modified (If-None-Match matched the stream ETag). Empty body, ETag header repeated.

404.description: No route matched under the mount.
